g.text: Tokens from app/css/main.css · components from app/js · v1.4.3 · 2026-09-16 · dark is the primary theme
Usage: bg-chat canvas · sidebar panels · bubble-in for received · bubble-out doubles as bg-active ·
accent for actions/links/unread · accent-2 p2p+local chat · green online/verified presence · danger destructive
Bubble-in is the page background (#f4f4f4) with a border — received messages read as paper on the grey-blue canvas.
Body 14 / 400 — message text, list rows, forms.
Caption 12.5 / 500 — day chips, bot chips, hints.
Reads like an identity, not a random avatar:
• every cell color comes from one fingerprint group
• neighboring cells never clash; no color repeats in a tile
• profile view captions each cell with its color name,
so two people can verify a fingerprint by words alone
• photo, when set, layers on top; tile stays underneath
pinned + muted + verified stack next to the name
Reactions render as chips on the bubble edge;
edited/starred flags live in the meta line.
input pill 999 · attach lives left of the field

svg.text: phone = single pane, drawer for the list

g.text: phone 380px: single pane, BACK pops the overlay history entry
≥760px: sidebar 280px + chat pane; the relay status line lives under the header
Hover — --bg-hover overlay on rows and buttons; never a color change on text.
Press — --bg-active on list rows; buttons dim to .8 opacity.
Delivery — pending ring spins (CSS .ticks-spin), flips to ticks; failed swaps the meta line for a Resend button.
Overlays — every fullscreen viewer pushes one history entry; BACK pops it. Safe areas: env(safe-area-inset-*) on the top bars.
